body.heading: Where in the world is Luxembourg?
paragraphs: Luxembourg is a country in Western Europe, which is part of Europe.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Luxembourg is Luxembourg.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: People in Luxembourg speak French, German and Luxembourgish.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Luxembourg is the euro. The euro is shared by many countries in Europe, so the same coins and notes work across borders.

body.heading: How big is Luxembourg?
paragraphs: Luxembourg covers about 3,000 square kilometres of land and inland water.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: The capital is a fortress city on cliffs, with a UNESCO old town and the Bock Casemates — kilometres of tunnels carved into the rock beneath it.
Vianden Castle is one of Europe's finest feudal residences, crowning a wooded hill town — ride the chairlift for the classic view.
